note: Rewritten from Emerson's (1928) description of the alate, soldier and worker of this species (given in the original as Mirotermes (Procubitermes) undulans Schmitz), the original in English; the description is based on two queens from the Stanleyville area and on several soldiers and workers from Ngayu and Stanleyville. OCR problems: the body-length row of the alate measurement table is missing (the figures on that line are not printed in the original), so it is not listed; the entry Length of queen 19.00 presumably refers to the queen body length and is recorded as in the original, marked as the queen.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Smaller than Mirotermes niapuensis, and the mandible shape also differs from it; identical with the Stanleyville material identified by Schmitz.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, oval; fontanelle small, white, with three muscle impressions in front of it. Segment 3 of the antenna about twice as long as segment 2 or 4, showing traces of subdivision. Eyes medium-sized, close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli medium-sized, separated from the compound eye by a distance greater than their own width. Postclypeus paler than the head, with an indistinct median longitudinal line. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, posterior margin concave. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum very narrowly concave. Measurements: head length 1.23, head width 1.10, eye diameter 0.38, pronotal length 0.57, pronotal width 0.97, hind tibia length 1.03 mm; queen body length 19.00 mm, abdominal width 3.00 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-yellow, rectangular, the sides straight and parallel; postmentum without a pointed projection. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 as long as segment 3, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Labrum deeply divided, the tips of both lobes rather pointed. Each mandible with a small tooth near the base; the left mandible unevenly curved, angled at two points; the right mandible evenly curved. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave. Measurements: head length with mandibles 3.05, head width 1.10, antennal length 2.00, pronotal length 0.26, pronotal width 0.67, hind tibia length 0.89, left mandible length 1.57 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Antennae 14-segmented. Measurements: head width 0.86 mm, hind tibia length 0.72 mm.
